timbaruka.p: [Timbaru+ka] (pu) CL=7 A homeless spiritual seeker who was named Timbaruka.
pn:
Timbaruka. A Paribbājaka who visited the Buddha at Sāvatthī and discussed with him the origin of pleasure and pain. The Buddha explained to him how ignorance was at the root of all conditioned existence.

It is said that Timbaruka became a follower of the Buddha (SN.ii.20f).

（၁） တည်ပင်၊ တရုပ်တည်ပင်၊ တည်ပင်ကြီး။ တိမ္ဗရူသက-（၁）-ကြည့်။ （၂） တိမ္ဗရု （ရူ）-အမည်ရှိသော၊ （က） ဂန္ဓဗ္ဗနတ်မင်း။ （ခ） ရေဆိပ်။ တိမ္ဗရူနာမက-ကြည့်။ （န） （၃） တည်သီး။ တိမ္ဗရုတ္ထနီ-ကြည့်။

timbaru：တိမ္ဗရု （ပ）

DOP: timbaru m. [ cf S. tumbaru, tumburu], a tree; SAF: false mangosteen, Diospyros malabarica (Desr.) Kostel.; its (golden) fruit ; ( also the name of a gandhabba); Abh 560 (tinduko kāḷakkhandho ca timbarūsakatimbarū); Ja V 406, 19´ (keṇū ti araññamāsā tindukā ti °-rukkhā, Be so; Ce, Se veṇū ti; Ee veṇū ti araññamāsā °-rukkhā); Vin-vn 2694 (badaraṃ ~ū); — °- aṭṭhi , n. , a stone of the timbaru fruit; Ja VI 336, 28´ (~in ti, Be, Ee so; Ce ~īnī ti; Se timbaruṭṭhin ti); — °- tthanī , ( m ) f ( n )., with breasts like the timbaru fruit ; Sn 110 (atītayobbano poso āneti ~iṃ tassā issā na supati; Pj II 172, 21 : ~in ti °-phala-sadisatthaniṃ taruṇadārikaṃ); Ja VI 457, 1* (nāganāsūru kalyāṇī paramā ~ī, Be so; Ce, Ee, Se paṭhamā ~ī; 457, 17´ : ~ī paramā uttamā suvaṇṇaphalake ṭhapitasuvaṇṇavaṇṇa-timbaruphaladvayam iv’ assā susaṇṭhānasampannaṃ nirantaraṃ thanayugalaṃ, Be so; Se paṭhamā uttamā …; Ce, Ee ~īnaṃ paṭhamā uttamā …); — °- nādasadiso in Ee at Vv-a 137, 30 (gandhabbasippe pariyodātasippatāya timbarunādasadiso) is prob. wr for timbarunāradasadiso ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — see also timbarukkha, timbarusa, timbarūsaka.

timbarūsakacoraka.p: [Timbarūsaka+cora+ka] (pu) CL=7 One who steals the persimmon fruits.

[တိမ္ဗရူသက+စောရ+က]
